name: Unborn Sorcery (Metamagic)
body:
Your connection to the powers of undeath allows you to achieve greater and greater success.

Prerequisite: Undead bloodline sorcerer or Undead creature type

Benefit: A number of times per day equal to 1 + your Charisma modifier you can change the energy type of an evocation spell you cast to negative energy. A unborn sorcery spell uses up a spell slot equal two levels higher than that spell’s actual level.
